officialAthleticsGuide2026.note: Page 39 of the 2026 guide supersedes the older athletics color reference. Its approved primary navy agrees with the institutional navy. The esports artwork itself contains a brighter blue, which is part of the supplied mark rather than a new palette token.

suppliedLogoSample.note: Dominant opaque raster pixels sampled from the project-supplied LeagueOS WebP. These are not published brand specifications.

colors.composition: Institutional navy and white lead. Secondary blue/gray support. Tertiary colors act as small refracted-light accents. Derived darks are backgrounds, not official brand swatches.

official.use: athletics headers and team names in the 2026 athletics guide

bundledOpenAlternates.role: scene headings, scores, labels, user interface

guideEsportsVariants.note: Extracted without redrawing from page 51 of the 2026 athletics guide. The dark samples include the guide's blue presentation field.

localReferences.role: project-supplied Messiah Esports Falcon mark; primary esports logo reference
localReferences.note: Unaltered transparent 512x512 RGBA WebP. Use for concept review. Request an original vector or larger approved source for final broadcast lockups.
Source file unchanged; RGB white background; reference and layout exploration.
Do not use as a production mark until Athletics supplies current approved artwork.

marks.productionRule: Use source esports artwork without redrawing or altering proportions. The 2026 guide says reproduction and use require Messiah Athletics permission and an electronic file is provided upon approval. Guide-extracted variants here support concept review; request those production files before public broadcast. Do not turn background flight motifs into a Falcon logo.

motion.loop: All plate geometry returns to the same state after 8 seconds.
motion.contrast: Keep detail, thin lines, and brighter color mainly outside the content-safe zone.
motion.export: The gallery can export a 1920x1080 PNG or record an 8-second silent WebM in Chrome/Edge. Review codec/playback before use in OBS.

provisionalAppProfile.note: Reserved proposal only. A functional profile still needs final marks, games, assets, defaults, and selected plate integration.
